test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the one word substitute for the below sentence.

Ravi marvelled at the diverse forms of life, including animals and plants, thriving in aquatic habitats.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Aquatic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Aquatic"** refers to something that is related to water or lives in or near water. (जल संबंधी)
 
 
• **Example:** Fishes, turtles, and dolphins are examples of aquatic animals.
 
 
• In the given sentence, aquatic habitats are mentioned, which include diverse forms of life thriving in water, such as animals and plants.
 
 
• **Example:** Ravi marvelled at the diverse forms of life, including animals and plants, thriving in aquatic habitats.
